items.text: Monthly retainers for ongoing management, project fees for campaigns and strategy work. Retainers start around £2,500 a month. We will tell you before a call whether we think we are the right fit for the budget.
Yes. Filming, editing and publishing are in-house for most accounts. For larger productions we bring in our own crew rather than outsourcing the account.

items.q: Which platforms do you work across?
items.text: TikTok and Instagram lead most of our work, with YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn and Pinterest where the audience is actually there. We would rather run two platforms properly than five badly.

Video-led accounts usually show movement inside 60 to 90 days. The Gigi Clothing account went from zero to a viral audience in under a year; Grace & Form sustained 400% month-on-month growth. We set expectations against the account, not the best case.

items.q: Do you work with founders and personal brands?
items.text: Often. Caroline Montague and Stéphanie Achar are both personal brands. It is the same discipline as a company account, with more care around voice.

items.q: What do you need from us?
items.text: Access, a point of contact who can approve things, and roughly a day a month of the founder or talent on camera. That is usually enough.
